keySentence: Jim acted bravely to save his friends despite his fear.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim came back safely with water! Everyone thanked Jim. Small actions can make a big difference. Jim acted bravely to save his friends despite his fear.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim returned to the fort safely with the water. Everyone was grateful and relieved to see him. The captain said Jim was the bravest person on the island. Even the pirates were surprised by Jim's courage. Jim acted bravely to save his friends despite his fear. Jim learned that anyone can be a hero through brave actions.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Jim successfully made it back to the fort carrying the precious water. His friends cheered with relief and gratitude when they saw him safe. The captain placed his hand on Jim's shoulder and called him a true hero. Even some of Silver's men were impressed by the boy's daring feat. Jim acted bravely to save his friends despite his fear. However, the real victory was not in the water itself but in Jim's courage to act. Because Jim chose to risk himself for others, he earned everyone's deep respect. This experience taught Jim that ordinary people can do extraordinary things when they care enough.
